name: @lares/agent-kit
description: Shared code for eve-based agent services (ORB-142), extracted so a fix lands once instead of once per agent — supersedes the earlier per-agent-duplication convention now that there are three agents, not two (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-21-agent-kit-extraction.md). telegram-markdown: markdown → Telegram HTML for every outbound send (ORB-112). schedule-gate: the EVE_SCHEDULES_LIVE cutover gate every schedule checks first. schedule-heartbeat: the pass/tick heartbeat rows every schedule stamps so a stopped schedule is visible as a row that stops aging (ORB-175). db: lazy pg.Pool singleton over DATABASE_URL. langfuse-otel: Langfuse as an OTLP trace backend. telegram-routes: the two webhook paths. telegram-reply-fix: the ORB-111 reply-swallow fix. telegram-fetch: outbound Telegram traffic routed through the shared squid proxy. gateway-provider: createGatewayProvider factory for the LiteLLM model gateway, parameterized per agent by default gateway-key file path (ORB-77); routes every model id through the gateway's router route so purpose aliases resolve (ORB-225). clock: Oslo wall-clock markdown block injected into every turn, so a model resolving "i morgen" has a real date instead of a training-prior guess. proactivity: the one gate every proactive message passes — quiet hours on the owner clock, DND, already-seen and the per-door/per-owner daily ceilings — plus the `initiations` ledger behind it (ORB-193). owner-clock: which timezone the owner is in right now, one answer for every agent (ORB-193). notes-store: the read engine behind the Brain/Atlas markdown stores — listing, tokenised search, backlinks, traversal-safe path resolution (ORB-51/ORB-52). note-tools: the searchTool/readTool/listTool/backlinksTool factory shared by Brain (mounted, extension-scoped) and Atlas (unmounted, local) — same mechanics, config-independent (ORB-143). note-lock: in-process + cross-process advisory lock serialising writers to the same vault note. note-paths: the title → `_inbox/<slug>.md` derivation shared by a write tool and the approval card that names what it is about to touch, so the two cannot drift. vault-git: the git mechanics (add/commit/push/mv/rm) behind the Brain write tools, never silently swallowing a push failure (ORB-51). vault-raw: an uncommitted write into the vault, for high-frequency untracked attachments. approval-summary: human-readable approval-card titles for every gated tool, read by eve's patched approval flow (ORB-121). slack-dispatcher: routes Slack-origin traffic through the sealed egress proxy while leaving every other origin's dispatcher untouched. manifest: the agent declaration (`agent.json`) — schema ported from the old runtime's adapters/loader.ts, autonomy semantics from its governance/decide.ts + ratchet.ts, plus `resolveExtensionTool`, the boot seam that decides per agent whether an extension tool is present and whether it is gated (ORB-144). google-auth: the Google OAuth PLUMBING only — decrypt, secret-file reads, the oauth_tokens row reads, egress-proxy pinning, and an authenticated OAuth2Client factory; the org registry, mailbox-selection policy and scope gating stay per-agent on purpose, because they are least-privilege boundaries that differ deliberately between agents (ORB-142).
